root_idea.summary: The root centers on taking a straight or rightly directed course, opposed to error and deviation.
root_idea.development: From the straightness of a path, the root develops meanings of right guidance, rectitude, sound judgment, maturity, rightly directed persons, and destinations toward which roads lead.

senses.definition: To take or follow a right way, course, or direction; to be rightly guided.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a road, an affair, or a person's direction in life; the course may include steadfast adherence to what is right.

senses.definition: One who directs or guides another to the right way.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle of Form IV, with a guiding or directing object understood from the construction.

senses.definition: A right way, course, or direction; a right course in an affair.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun denotes right direction or a right outcome without requiring a distinction between worldly and otherworldly affairs.

senses.definition: Rectitude, right guidance, or the right way, opposed to error and deviation.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for right direction in religious or general affairs, including a person's being shown or given the right way.

senses.definition: Maturity of intellect, sound judgment, and capacity for proper management of affairs.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic property context, it concerns recognizing an orphan's maturity and discretion sufficient for responsible management.

senses.definition: Right procedure or the adoption and pursuit of a right way, course, or direction.
senses.usage_conditions: May describe right conduct in a road or an affair; the Quranic occurrences present it as the right course to which one guides another.

senses.definition: Right-minded, rightly directed, or soundly conducted.
senses.usage_conditions: May qualify a person as following a right course or an affair as soundly directed; the Quran applies it to both kinds of subject.

senses.definition: One who takes or follows a right course; rightly guided.
senses.usage_conditions: The supplied Quran occurrence is plural; the public headword is normalized to the singular active-participial citation form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold a right belief or be orthodox.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A religious application of taking the right course, contrasted with error or deviation.
A religious extension of right procedure, contrasted with error and deviation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pronounce or make someone rightly directed or right-minded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II construction, including the use of a judge declaring someone to be rightly guided or orthodox.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to hold a right belief or become orthodox.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The religious application of the Form IV causative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or ask for direction to the right way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May mean seeking to follow a right course oneself or requesting direction to it from another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode, manner, or act of right procedure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use related to right procedure or conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Legitimate or trueborn descent; an offspring of valid marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in idioms contrasting lawful birth with illegitimate birth, and in expressions about claiming a child as one's own.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name for garden cress or its seed, and related cress plants.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical and dialectal use; in the cited Iraqi usage it is equated with الحُرْف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Director to the right way; one who appoints or ordains well and whose regulations reach their proper aims.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A divine epithet, distinct from the ordinary human or situational adjective meaning rightly directed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A surname for the female rat or mouse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed lexical surname or epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most direct, especially of a road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression الطريق الأرشد, the more or most direct road.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The right places toward which roads lead; destinations of roads.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural form reported without a singular.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Verb and related verbal-noun meanings, including right belief, are represented.
Form IV guiding and religious causative uses.
Divine epithet and its associated meanings.
Rightly directed person and conventional applications.
Superlative meaning applied to a road.

cautions: A reported attempt to restrict رَشَد to matters of the afterlife and رُشْد to worldly matters is not consistent with the recorded Arabic usage or Quranic readings.
The public verb headword is the classical perfect citation form رَشَدَ, although the supplied Quran occurrence is an imperfect plural form.
